intended_object: An auxiliary balanced map (ι →₀ Rᵐᵒᵖ) × N → (ι →₀ N), (x, n) ↦ Σᵢ xᵢ·n placed in coordinate i. Its only job is to be lifted to `freeToFinsupp`, which helps prove the isomorphism (R^(ι)) ⊗_R N ≅ N^(ι). This comes from the docstring "The balanced map used by `freeToFinsupp`".
explanation: The docstring says this is the balanced map used by `freeToFinsupp`. In the file, its only use is `freeToFinsupp := lift freeBalancedMap` (line 185), and that map is then used to build the isomorphism between the balanced tensor product with a free module and finsupps. So it is a helper for one proof step, the bundled bilinear data passed to the universal property, and not a standard mathematical object in its own right. The map itself is the expected one: (x, n) ↦ Σᵢ single i (xᵢ • n). Its additivity and balance conditions are proved in the body.
